readout_other: triceps EMG success rate; c-fos immunofluorescence; Evans blue extravasation; HE and TUNEL staining
direction_notes: Intravenous microbubbles increased the success rate of EMG motor responses and c-fos+ cell density at both 0.12 and 0.25 MPa relative to ultrasound alone.
safety_notes: 0.25 MPa with microbubbles opened the BBB (Evans blue extravasation); 0.12 MPa did not. HE and TUNEL showed no tissue damage, haemorrhage or apoptosis after 0.25 MPa with microbubbles.

exposures.label: 0.12 and 0.25 MPa, with and without microbubbles

timing.protocol_description: Pulses of 2 ms duration at 250 Hz PRF, total sonication 400 ms; twenty stimulations at 8 s intervals per condition. For c-fos and histology the motor cortex was stimulated for 30 min in 8 s intervals, with microbubbles injected every 10 min.
